false_flags_resolved.why: Tesseract misread «المظاهر» as «الظاهر» and garbled «(١) لا يثيبكم»; the garbled OCR line failed the coverage match. Gemini's reading «لا يثيبكم على المظاهر» is correct (confirmed by rawan). The assistant's proposed correction «الظاهر» came from the Tesseract reading and was wrong; it was not applied.
